photos.desc: Nom français : avoine cultivée. Nom anglais : cultivated oats. Inflorescence (panicule, épillets) d'avoine cultivée.

photos.file: Avena sativa habit6 NC - Flickr - Macleay Grass Man.jpg
photos.desc: Introduced, cool season, annual, semi-prostrate to erect, tufted grass to 1.5m tall. Flowerheads are open panicles to 40cm long. Spikelets are 1.7–2.5 cm long (without the awns), each with 1–7 florets
The edge of a small oat field at Gåseberg, Lysekil Municipality, Sweden.
